content.short: Reclaims SOL by closing unused Solana accounts and burning tokens with BetterClaimSol.
content.description: BetterClaimSol helps Solana users reclaim SOL that is locked in wallets by identifying unused accounts, closing them, and burning tokens. The service covers transaction fees for empty accounts, removing barriers to recovering funds and making the reclaim process straightforward and accessible for anyone. It also offers a referral program with a 50% reward to encourage sharing the solution and boosting returns. This approach reduces friction and speeds up access to reclaimed SOL.
